cohort: The study included 3340 twins from the East Flanders Prospective Twin Survey.
finding: Higher maternal exposure to PM10 and NO2 during the third trimester was associated with decreased placental weight and an increased birth weight/placental weight ratio in moderate to late preterm twins with separate placentas.
birth_weight: implicitly included as part of birth weight/placental weight ratio
gest_age: moderate to late preterm, used in definition of small for gestational age placenta
